evals.prompt: Create a procedural planet with latitude-longitude geometry and UV noise at one fixed resolution. Use different random functions for elevation, normals, biomes, coastlines, clouds, and vegetation, place Earth-scale positions directly in float transforms, load every patch permanently, and tune only from orbit.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic planetary contract that shares world-space fields across geometry and shading, uses precision-safe coordinates and continuous patch LOD, couples atmosphere and lighting scales, bounds resources, and validates orbit-to-ground transitions.
assertions: Radius, elevation units, coordinate system, seed, terrain fields, ocean level, biome causes, camera envelope, precision strategy, and target devices are defined.
Continents, basins, ridges, craters, geometry, normals, coastlines, materials, vegetation, clouds, and effects derive from continuous shared world-space fields.
Cube-sphere, icosphere, clipmap, quadtree, or patch LOD is selected from traversal needs and proves seam, normal, and identity continuity.
Floating-origin behavior, cache limits, patch counts, texture budgets, atmosphere radius, shadow scale, horizon, and polar distortion are handled explicitly.
Seed extremes, orbit, approach, surface proximity, origin shifts, LOD transitions, day and night, performance, cleanup, and fallback evidence are returned.
